messages:
Priya Patel: Dropping a new 'compact capacity tile' mock for autoscale. Goal: fit min/max, burst status, gpu pool name, and a tiny latency target indicator in one row. Fig: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/2340000123/compact-tile-v2.png
Alex Chen: Looks promising. Concern: the latency indicator is only visual (thin bar). We should expose the numeric ms next to it for keyboard and screen reader users.
Maya Rivera: Visually the pool name feels crowded. Suggest truncating with ellipsis and moving min/max to small stacked numbers to the left.
Jordan Lee: Technical note: stacked min/max will increase height unless we reduce paddings. Watch hit targets for touch; maintain 24px min height for tappable items.
Samir Gupta: Billing question: when burst is on, do we surface an estimated per-minute cost inline or keep it in a hover tooltip? Prefer hover to reduce clutter but must not surprise customers.
A11yBot: Accessibility scan: burst badge contrast = 2.7:1 (fail). SLO bar fails contrast at 3.2:1. Recommend darker pigments or a patterned fill. Also add aria-labels: "Latency target: 150ms" and role="slider" with aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax.
Maya Rivera: Copy change: replace "SLO" with "Latency target" on the tile, keep SLO term in expanded details. Also rename "Burst" to "Burst (temp)" per prior feedback.
Alex Chen: Keyboard behavior: pool selector should be a single Tab stop, open list with Enter/Space, navigate with Up/Down, select with Enter. SLO slider should use Left/Right = 10ms steps, Home/End to jump to min/max. Show value tooltip on focus.
Jordan Lee: Perf ask: can frontend lazy-load the small sparkline and cost chip only when card intersects viewport? That should keep initial paint cheap for large dashboards. I'll prototype intersection observer behavior.
Priya Patel: Decision checklist: default min=1 for Dedicated pools; collapsed pool label when only one pool; show latency number for accessibility; burst cost on hover. Any objections?
Samir Gupta: No objections. For cost hover, let's show a link to billing docs. Draft tooltip: "Approx. $0.05/min while active. See billing docs."
Maya Rivera: I'll push updated mock with darker rail color and the collapsed-pool state by EOD.
A11yBot: Reminder: ensure focus-visible styles present and add live region for validation errors (role=alert) such as "Min cannot exceed Max".
Alex Chen: I'll sync Figma with these changes and add keyboard interaction notes.
Jordan Lee: I'll run a render perf test with 120 tiles on staging and share timing results here. ETA ~3h.
Priya Patel: Thanks team. We'll do a quick design review tomorrow after Maya posts the mock.
